title: Lie Ideals and Lie Derivations of the Algebraic Toeplitz Algebra
summary: Let $K$ be a field and let $\T=L_K(E_T)$ be the algebraic Toeplitz algebra. We classify the Lie ideals of $\T^-$. If $w$ is the sink of the Toeplitz graph and $F=I(w)$, then $F\cong M_\infty(K)$, $\T/F\cong K[t,t^{-1}]$, and $[\T,\T]=F$. We prove that every noncentral Lie ideal contains $\mathfrak s=[F,F]$, the finitary trace-zero Lie algebra. Thus the classification reduces to the Heisenberg-type quotient $\T/\mathfrak s$.
